  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "cea19d45-76ba-4af6-b8d7-a9c8208da74f",

   "source": [
    "## BAR CHART"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 144,
   "id": "315195df-94a7-40c8-8876-09fc60c6ba72",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Apply the ggplot style to make charts visually clear and consistent\n",
    "plt.style.use(\"ggplot\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 145,
   "id": "28be8c20-2192-4f5b-a78d-850d4f6c3d0e",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Create a figure with a suitable size for the bar chart\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create a bar chart to compare the average GDP of different countries\n",
    "sns.barplot( data=df, x=\"Country\", y=\"GDP_Value_USD_Bn\", estimator=np.mean,color='blue')\n",
    "\n",
    "# Rotate country names by 45 degrees so they are easier to read\n",
    "plt.xticks(rotation=45)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Add a title to explain what the chart represents\n",
    "plt.title(\"Average GDP by Country\",color='red')\n",
    "\n",
    "#for axis name and color\n",
    "plt.ylabel(\"GDP_Value_USD_Bn\",color='purple')\n",
    "plt.xlabel(\"Country\",color='purple')\n",
    "\n",
    "# Display the completed chart\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a171dd9d-1c42-41e2-87c7-43036d7893ce",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [

   "source": [
    "# Count the records of each sector and display their percentage distribution as a pie chart\n",

   "source": [
    "# BUSINESS INSIGHTS"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "d2314836-bf49-4747-b86d-46e175b79ef6",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 1.\tWhich country contributes the highest total GDP? "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "raw",
   "id": "dc1d359e-f927-4fe1-9ced-23d118859b4b",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The India contributes the highest total GDP among all the countries in the dataset. This indicates that it has the \n",
    "largest overall economic output compared to the other countries included in the analysis."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "fceb6877-f842-4dca-9a13-f655def9b633",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 2.\tWhich sector has the highest average GDP? "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "dc2367fc-9f3c-4850-801a-d74c628b73cc",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The Manufacturing sector has the highest average GDP. This shows that the services industry is the largest\n",
    "contributor to economic growth and plays a significant role in the economy."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "e422e425-64c6-4087-ad52-9119f0a889de",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 3.\tWhich sector employs the largest workforce? "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "75702d97-c567-476d-be60-9d3b12e7f2ac",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The Agriculture sector employs the largest workforce among all sectors. This suggests that agriculture remains one \n",
    "of the major sources of employment in the countries included in the dataset."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "b4832cc4-066f-46ad-a7dc-563cedc0f502",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 4.\tIs there any relationship between employment and GDP? "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "2a7650c7-11fd-4ceb-bb33-9df6e89bcc12",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "Yes, there is a positive relationship between employment and GDP. The analysis indicates that sectors with higher \n",
    "employment generally tend to contribute more to GDP."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "21d72b47-a272-4dbb-8b06-2b63b65e6c0c",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 5.\tWhich year recorded the highest GDP? "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "raw",
   "id": "bbd42c41-0d5c-41f8-8b26-d6d943f809e7",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The year 2011 recorded the highest total GDP in the dataset. This indicates that economic output was at its highest during that year."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "477ff26a-0e69-4ef8-b40e-c0e0d8768206",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 6.\tWhich country has the highest economic growth? "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "raw",
   "id": "acbdee81-e6ea-4840-83a1-2759849adb79",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The analysis shows that UK recorded the highest average economic growth rate among all the countries in the dataset. \n",
    "This indicates strong economic performance and consistent growth during the analyzed period."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "2404a8f3-d375-40d7-8088-b6751a5587ec",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 7.\tWhich sector has the lowest growth? "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "raw",
   "id": "b7c1b72d-739f-4305-8ccf-2677bb52f3a4",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The Agriculture sector has the lowest average growth rate. This suggests that the sector experienced slower economic expansion \n",
    "compared to the other sectors."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "782a9f37-9b05-4824-bc50-bf0d668c1920",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 8. Are there any outliers in GDP?"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "raw",
   "id": "799d5b46-7574-40b3-b7b7-efaf392f0031",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "No. Based on the box plot analysis, no significant outliers were observed in the GDP values.\n",
    "All data points lie within the whisker limits, indicating that the GDP values are reasonably distributed without \n",
    "any unusually high or low observations."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "bf82f6b7-3c28-411b-a4ef-a07e2f871abd",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 9.\tWhich variables are positively correlated? "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "raw",
   "id": "9f6db719-51f7-4dc9-8128-4aa419394a06",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The correlation analysis shows that there is no strong positive correlation between any of the variables. \n",
    "The highest positive correlation is between Employment Percentage and Growth Rate (0.0046), but this value is\n",
    "very close to zero, indicating an extremely weak positive relationship."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "9354f0b9-5301-4200-886f-b9938c88241a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 10. Which variables are negatively correlated?"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "raw",
   "id": "d8336f0d-447a-4779-bdca-d20355a987f4",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The analysis shows no strong negative correlation among the variables. Very weak negative correlations exist between\n",
    "Year and Employment Percentage (-0.0113), Year and Growth Rate (-0.0104), and GDP Value and Growth Rate (-0.0038).\n",
    "However, these values are close to zero and do not indicate a meaningful negative relationship."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "d4feda16-bc88-4d94-bd49-2cd0317957ea",
   "metadata": {},

  },

  {

   "id": "2bf0efdb-0ff1-4b5d-ad29-bd702f05c378",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    ">> The dataset contains information about different countries, economic sectors, GDP values, employment percentages, and annual growth rates.\n",
    ">> It includes both Indian and global economic sector data across multiple years.\n",
    ">> objective is to analyze sector-wise and country-wise economic performance using Python"
   ]
  },
  {

   "metadata": {},

  },
  {
   "cell_type": "raw",
   "id": "813ec0f0-73a1-4498-a503-8c1bfab682f9",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    ">> Checked the dataset structure using info(), shape(), and dtypes.\n",
    ">> Identified missing values and calculated their percentages.\n",
    ">> Checked duplicate records to avoid conflicts.\n",
    ">> Converted columns such as Employment_% and Growth_Rate_% from text to numeric format.\n",
    ">> Filled missing values in numerical columns using appropriate statistical methods (mean/median).\n",
    ">> Verified the dataset after cleaning to ensure consistency."
   ]
  },
  {

   "id": "42d0a543-a87b-44d6-aeff-f88e524f242e",

  },
  {
   "cell_type": "raw",
   "id": "239900f1-fd42-46bb-ac2f-4a59de545233",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    ">> The Services sector contributes the highest GDP in most countries.\n",
    ">> Employment percentages differ significantly across sectors.\n",
    ">> Some countries show consistently higher GDP values than others.\n",
    ">> GDP and employment exhibit varying relationships depending on the economic sector.\n",
    ">> Growth rates vary across countries and sectors, indicating differences in economic performance."

   "metadata": {},
   "source": [

    ">> Pie Chart – Distribution of Economic Sectors.\n",
